testsuite.name: detectBreachesAtTime

testcase.name: should update multiple tickets with different breach types
should update ticket sla_status when breach detected
should return 0 when no tickets have breached SLA
should transition from ACK_BREACHED to BOTH_BREACHED when resolution also breaches
should not save ticket if sla_status has not changed
